summary: Iteration 5 retest of the post-iteration_4 fixes. Three of the four live-mode endpoints now return HTTP 424 with the app's JSON detail through Cloudflare: google/connect, google/status and sync. The Connect Gmail and Refresh toasts show the app's message ('... failed. COMPOSIO_API_KEY is not set'). competitors/find still returns 200 [] with no Exa key, so no error and no toast appear. The stale guest flag fix does NOT work: /dashboard shows the loader for about 7s while /api/me is retried 4 times (all 401), then shows 'Couldn't load your profile. Refresh to try again.' and never redirects to /. The guest flow passes: Try button, guest-bar, Demo story note, Beta Corp first, why box 'Score: 3.46'. The demo investor email adds 'Share the data room with Alex at Seed Capital' at #3. Founder manual mode shows the PriorityBoard. Golden pipeline tests: 15/15 pass.

minor.issue: Returns 200 [] instead of 424 when EXA_API_KEY is missing. market.find_candidates wraps each _exa call in try/except and does `continue`, so the RuntimeError('EXA_API_KEY is not set') never reaches routes._fail. Fix: check the key up front, or re-raise if every call failed (e.g. track the last error and raise it if out is empty and all calls errored).

ui_bugs.issue: Still a dead end. Repro: on / set localStorage aoc_guest='1' with no aoc_guest cookie, then open /dashboard. The loader shows for about 7s (react-query retries the 401 three times), then the page shows 'Couldn't load your profile. Refresh to try again.' The flag is cleared, but the URL stays /dashboard. RCA: localStorage.removeItem is a side effect inside render. Under React.StrictMode (index.js) the component renders twice. The first render removes the flag and returns <Navigate>; the second render sees isGuest()===false and falls through to the 'Couldn't load' branch, and that result is committed. Fix: don't gate on isGuest() after mutating it. Capture `const guest = isGuest()` once via useState/useRef, or do the removal in a useEffect or the axios interceptor. Also set retry: (n, e) => e?.response?.status !== 401 && n < 3 on useMe so a 401 fails immediately.

integration_issues.flow: Connections > Find competitors (live, no Exa key)
integration_issues.issue: Clicking Find shows no toast and no result, so the user isn't told why (follows from the backend 200 [] above).

issues: Google status error is still the generic 'Couldn't check Google right now.' The 424 detail is now available, so errorText(google.error) could be shown.

action_items: Fix the stale guest redirect in Guards.jsx: no localStorage mutation during render (StrictMode double render), and don't retry /me on 401.
Make /api/advisor/competitors/find return 424 when EXA_API_KEY is missing or all Exa calls fail, so the UI toast shows the reason.
critical_code_review_comments: Guards.jsx: side effect in render (localStorage.removeItem). Move it to an effect or the API interceptor.
market.find_candidates swallows every exception, so configuration errors are indistinguishable from 'no competitors found'.
clerk_auth.py:90 still returns a bare 502 (intentional for Clerk's retry), but Cloudflare will replace that body with HTML too. This is fine as long as no client reads the body.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_live_failures_424.py tests/test_advisor_pipeline.py -n 0. The live fixture sets the founder to live and restores manual on teardown. Stale flag repro: open /, set localStorage aoc_guest='1', goto /dashboard, poll the URL for 10s; expect a redirect to /.
rca of the issue: Stale guest: StrictMode double render plus a mutation in render means the committed render takes the error branch. Competitors 200: per-call try/except/continue in market.find_candidates hides the missing EXA key.
